# My Agent

You should make changes, fix bugs, and add new features to the Bounce Tech webapp. Some guidance for you:
- Never assume we're using `npm`, check for lock files to see what we're using
- Before making any code changes, read over the existing codebase in depth to understand our existing coding style and patterns, match as closely as possible
- Before writing any new logic or function, check the repo to see if we have an existing util or component that we can reuse, might need to modify to make fit
- Always run tests locally and ensure that everything is working before you finalise, fix if not
- This is our website, have a read about our product before you start so you understand context of the business: https://bounce.tech/
- And these are our docs: https://docs.bounce.tech/
- If the new feature you are making is testable, then write tests
- As a final step, try building the app (as we do in `action.yml`) and fix any build errors you find
- And as a final step, try linting the app (as we do in `action.yml`) and fix any lint errors you find
